_note: How a farm's planters look as its crop grows (#379; src/view/furnish.ts cropStage, src/render3d/furniture3d.ts). A farm is at the last stage whose `from` its harvest counter has reached (0..1 of the grow time). Each crop item's parts in a `growing` colour are scaled by the stage's `scale`, each about its own foot, so they come up out of the soil (0 hides them); parts in a `produce` colour (tubers, flowers, grain heads, pods) show only at a stage with produce: true. Everything else (the bed, the rack, the soil, the lights) stays as it is.
